note: One ability per vehicle. effect picks the code path; the other columns are its numbers (0 when unused). power and power2 mean: sabot = penetration and damage multipliers; concussion = stun seconds; boost = speed multiplier.

rows.name: Bulwark
rows.description: Braces the hull for 6 seconds: armour is 50% thicker and all damage taken is cut by 40%.

rows.name: Smoke Screen
rows.description: Drops a 20 m smoke cloud for 12 seconds. Nobody can spot or aim through it.

rows.name: Rapid Load
rows.description: The loader goes flat out: reloads 2.5 times faster for 6 seconds.

rows.name: Sabot Round
rows.description: Your next shell within 10 seconds is a sabot dart: 60% more penetration and 40% more damage.

rows.name: Concussion Shell
rows.description: Your next shell within 12 seconds stuns every enemy within 14 m of the blast: tracks and gun out for 6 seconds.

rows.name: Recon Scan
rows.description: Marks every enemy within 450 m for your whole team for 8 seconds, even behind cover.

rows.name: Field Repair
rows.description: Fixes all modules and restores 30% health for every ally within 45 m, yourself included.

rows.name: Overdrive
rows.description: Engine overdrive: 60% more speed and acceleration for 5 seconds.

rows.name: Sky Scan
rows.description: Radar sweep: marks every enemy aircraft for your whole team for 14 seconds, wherever it is.
